# VNMSFX

> VNMSFX traces one important food and beverage process, shows what is actually happening and—when a useful fix is worth building—creates a client-owned AI system that keeps watching it. Built once, yours to keep. Founder: Brandon Adams, New York.

## Engagements
- Free teardown (30 minutes): VNMSFX leads the conversation. The founder gives a quick picture of how the business sells and how work moves through the team. VNMSFX asks the questions, recommends one process worth reviewing or says it is not a fit. The founder does not need to diagnose the problem or design the Audit. Do not send passwords or confidential records. Book: https://cal.com/vnmsfx/30min
- The Leak Audit ($2,500): VNMSFX follows one important process from start to finish. Before payment, VNMSFX writes a one-page plan naming where the process starts and ends, the records and dates it will review and what sits outside the Audit. The client approves the boundaries. Once the plan and agreement are signed, payment clears, the needed records, access and client decisions are ready, and VNMSFX confirms the start, VNMSFX delivers within five business days. The client receives the report, the proof behind it, what needs attention and—when the Audit supports a useful standard Build—the system VNMSFX recommends, plus a 60-minute walkthrough. The Audit does not install or operate an ongoing system, change source records or send customer or vendor messages. Fictional examples: https://vnmsfx.com/sample-audit
- Full-refund promise: if VNMSFX completes the Audit and finds nothing real, VNMSFX refunds the full $2,500 and the client keeps the report. A hunch, an inaccessible file, possible upside or a maybe does not count. A missing required record counts only if the written plan says where it should exist and every agreed place is checked. "Real" means at least one item covered by the written Audit plan crossed the rule approved before payment. The result covers only the process, records and dates in the written plan—not the client's whole business. If the plan reviews only part of the records, the exact subset and how it is chosen are approved in writing before payment.
- The standard Build ($5,000 per month for three months): one client-owned AI system for the process reviewed in the Audit, using up to four included sources across the full project. Before signing, the Build Plan lists everything the system will do and how it will be tested. The first working part is ready to test within 10 business days after the Build project starts. Every part listed in the plan is ready for final testing by the end of week eight. Month three covers final testing, training and handover, followed by 30 days of no-cost fixes if the accepted system fails one of the written tests it passed at handover.
- The Audit does not automatically become a Build. VNMSFX recommends the Build only when the records support one useful system that fits the standard price, timing and project limits. If they do not, the client keeps the completed Audit and VNMSFX stops there rather than inventing work.
- Payment inside the 60-calendar-day credit window: after a completed, non-refunded Audit, the client must sign the Build agreement and make the first Build payment within 60 calendar days. Audit $2,500; Build month one $2,500 after the Audit credit; Build month two $5,000; Build month three $5,000. Total from Audit through handover: $15,000. After 60 calendar days, the credit ends and a new Audit is required. At today's prices, starting again would be a new $15,000 Audit-to-handover project; the earlier $2,500 remains money already spent.
- One included source means one separately connected account or one regularly delivered file—not every document inside it. Separate stores, company accounts or mailboxes count separately. A source uses one of the four shared Audit-and-Build spots when VNMSFX first works on it, even if it later cannot be used.
- Third-party tools are paid directly by the client with no VNMSFX markup and sit outside the $15,000. Most small-brand Builds should plan for about $100–$300 a month. A lean setup may be $50–$125; a complex or high-volume setup may be $300–$800 or more. Before the Build agreement is signed or its first payment is made, the client receives the exact tools, expected cost and approved spending limit.
- Launch price: $15,000 applies to the first two complete VNMSFX Builds. Pricing will be reviewed after those Builds are documented.

## Data boundary
Do not send passwords, private exports, financial records, customer lists or confidential screen-share through this website or the free teardown. Before any paid work handles private records, the written agreement names the records, access method, business AI product and company account, client-owned workspace, data rules and how access is removed when work ends. Personal consumer AI accounts never receive client data. Access uses a named account, approved connection or client-created export, never a shared password. The standard system does not change books, orders, inventory or payments or send customer or vendor messages. It may deliver results to the named person on the client's team. AI may help read and organize records, but an important answer must show the original records, the agreed rule and what is missing. The client's team makes the final decision. Private-data work does not begin until those controls are agreed and tested. Security: https://vnmsfx.com/security. Offer summary: https://vnmsfx.com/terms
